onboarding.slide1Description: Evaria Cycles & Wellness is a science-informed cycle-tracking tool designed to help women honor the gift of their bodies. We provide comprehensive resources, access to trusted experts, and opportunities for spiritual formation.
onboarding.slide2Description: Go beyond period tracking—learn the four cycle phases, what biomarkers reveal about your Fertility, and how daily insights help you make informed choices for general wellness, nutrition, energy, and fertility.
onboarding.slide3Description: Your questions deserve expert answers. See how to easily connect with our network of fertility care professionals directly from the app.
onboarding.slide4Description: Discover how to access our curated resources that explore the beauty of the body, the vocation of love, and personal identity from a faithfully Catholic perspective.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: CWCNP is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you use our medical consultation app.

information.title: 1. Information We Collect
items: Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number, date of birth, and any medical information you provide.
Health Information: Details about your medical history, symptoms, and consultation records.
Device Information: Information such as your IP address, device type, operating system, and app usage data.

usage.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
items: Facilitate communication between you and healthcare professionals.
Improve our app's functionality and user experience.
Comply with legal and regulatory requirements.

questions.period: How long does a period usually last?
questions.tracking: Why should I track my cycle?

answers.bbt: Basal Body Temperature (BBT) is your body's lowest resting temperature, usually measured right after waking up in the morning, before getting out of bed or doing any activity. It reflects subtle changes in your hormones during the menstrual cycle.
answers.cycle: A menstrual cycle is the monthly hormonal process that prepares your body for a possible pregnancy. It starts on the first day of your period and ends when your next period begins.
answers.ovulation: Ovulation is the process in which an ovary releases an egg. It generally occurs once during a menstrual cycle.
answers.period: A menstrual period commonly lasts between 2 and 7 days. Duration can vary from person to person.
answers.hormones: Hormones help regulate your menstrual cycle, ovulation, and other reproductive processes. Their levels naturally change throughout your cycle.
answers.fertileWindow: The fertile window is the period during which pregnancy is possible. It includes the days leading up to ovulation and the day of ovulation.
answers.tracking: Tracking your menstrual cycle can help you understand your cycle patterns, notice changes, and keep a record of symptoms.
